evidence.title: ERP annual spend baseline
evidence.claim: ERP and corporate application spend is $92M annually.

evidence.title: Quality release cycle baseline
evidence.claim: Average quality release cycle time is 11.8 days.

evidence.title: SI proposal comparability gap
evidence.claim: Current vendor submissions do not normalize data-conversion and validation-testing scope.

evidence.title: Quality master-data ownership gap
evidence.claim: Deviation taxonomy and CAPA root-cause coding ownership are not recorded.

evidence.title: Validated-system transition risk
evidence.claim: Manufacturing and quality systems require validated-system controls in any SI transition.
